## Research resources

### Software and data

**EchoGO** · Open-source framework for annotation-context-aware functional interpretation in transcriptomics.  
Role: lead conceptual development, workflow design and implementation.  
[MethodsX paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.mex.2026.104222) · [GitHub repository](https://github.com/miloes114/EchoGo) · [Zenodo software archive](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17658714)

**Gammarus pulex de novo transcriptomic resource** · Peer-reviewed transcriptome assembly and annotation for ecotoxicogenomics.

**Holtemme Gammarus ecotoxicogenomics reproducible research compendium** · [Public GitHub repository](https://github.com/miloes114/holtemme-gammarus-ecotoxicogenomics)

### Science communication

Science communication for broad audiences, including an explainer article for *Frontiers for Young Minds*.
